profitsPassword.tooShort: Password must be at least {{min}} characters
profitsPassword.intro: This password is required from EVERYONE — including admins — on every visit to the Profits page. A correct password unlocks Profits for 15 minutes; navigating away locks it again immediately.

devices.revokeConfirm: End this session? That device will be signed out.
devices.revokeOthersConfirm: Sign out every other device? This device stays signed in; every other session for your account ends.
devices.revokeOthersFailed: Failed to sign out other devices
devices.noOthers: No other devices were signed in
devices.intro: Review your active sessions. Sign out of devices you no longer use. To sign out this device, use its Sign out button.

resetModal.title: Reset all data?

license.managed: Your plan is managed by LiraTek and applies automatically to this account — there is no licence key to enter here.

license.readOnly: Read-only — viewing and exporting still work

pairedPcs.loadFailed: Could not load the paired PCs
pairedPcs.renumberFailed: Could not ask the PC to renumber
pairedPcs.title: Paired PCs
pairedPcs.intro: Desktop PCs that keep a copy of the shop and can keep working when the internet is down.
pairedPcs.confirmUnpair: Unpair {{name}}? It will need to be paired again by an admin. Work it already sent is still booked.
pairedPcs.confirmRenumber: Renumber the unsent work of {{name}}? The next time it connects, it gives its waiting items new numbers after the last one the server has, and sends them again. Nothing is booked twice.

result.linked: Google is now connected. You can sign in with it.

paymentMethods.title: Payment Methods
paymentMethods.intro: Configure which payment methods are available across all features.
paymentMethods.footnote: System methods (🔒) cannot be deleted. DEBT does not affect any drawer balance.

serviceProviders.title: Service Providers
serviceProviders.intro: Provider taxonomy for financial services (OMT/Whish/recharge transfers) and partner "System Association". New providers always settle cash to the General drawer.
serviceProviders.generalDrawer: This provider's cash will settle to the General drawer. Only OMT and Whish have their own dedicated system drawer.
serviceProviders.hasChildren: "{{name}}" already has its own children grouped under it — an account parent cannot also become a child.
serviceProviders.accountHint: Draws on that supplier's open-credit account instead of settling on its own (e.g. iPick / OMT App under OMT).
serviceProviders.noLedger: No supplier ledger is linked to this provider — account grouping doesn't apply.
serviceProviders.footnote: System providers (🔒) cannot be deleted. A provider's code can never be changed once created.

carrierLines.title: Carrier Lines
carrierLines.intro: Track the shop's own alfa/mtc SIM numbers — remaining credits and validity expiry. Informational only; updates here don't affect any drawer or checkout.
carrierLines.label: Label (optional)
